# PngSuite (`pngsuite`), for `clazel-png`

Upstream: https://www.schaik.com/pngsuite/
SHA-256: 0294b244c95a8342c01b00010cf34abdcabc7c6a34fd0fe1bd963917537bfdc8
License: its own notice, `LICENSE.md` beside this file, unchanged (the archive's `PngSuite.LICENSE`): "Permission to use, copy, modify and distribute these images for any purpose and without fee is hereby granted." (c) Willem van Schaik, 1996, 2011

The `SHA-256:` is that of the archive `PngSuite-2017jul19.tgz` (68,521 bytes), fetched 2026-11-17 from http://www.schaik.com/pngsuite/PngSuite-2017jul19.tgz: the site serves no HTTPS, so the hash is what authenticates the copy (the `Upstream:` line is the site's address as the checker requires it).

Deviation from the plan: phase-6.md 6.1 says "the 2011 archive"; the site now serves only the 2017-07-19 archive, which holds the 2011 files plus a few added since. All 176 `.png` files of it are vendored, byte for byte, unmodified. The archive's `PngSuite.README` is not vendored (it only describes the suite and repeats the author's address). The 14 `x*.png` files are the corrupt ones a decoder must refuse; the rest are valid.
